title: Connect or reconnect a bank feed
body: Go to Banking > Bank accounts > Add account, search for your bank and sign in through the secure bank window. To fix a feed that stopped importing, open the account, choose Reconnect and re-authorise; most banks require re-authorisation every 90 days. New transactions appear within a few minutes of reconnecting.

title: Reconcile bank transactions
body: Open Banking > Reconcile, then pick the account and statement date. Accept suggested matches, or choose Create to add a new transaction or Match to link existing ones. The reconciliation is complete when the difference reads 0.00. You can undo the latest reconciliation from the same screen.

title: Create and send an invoice
body: Go to Sales > Invoices > New invoice, choose the customer, add line items and set the payment terms. Select Send to email the invoice with a payment link, or Save as draft to finish later. Sent invoices can be voided but not deleted.

title: Export invoices and reports to PDF or CSV
body: Open Sales > Invoices, tick one or more invoices and choose Export. Pick PDF for printable copies or CSV for spreadsheets. Every report has an Export button in the top right with the same two formats. CSV files use the date format set in Settings > Regional.

title: Refund policy
body: Subscription charges can be refunded within 30 days of the order date; charges older than 30 days are not eligible. Support can propose a refund of up to 200 USD per request. Refunds above 200 USD need approval from a human billing specialist. A refund returns to the original payment method in 5 to 10 business days. A duplicate charge is refunded in full within the window. Never promise a refund before it is approved.

title: Billing FAQ
body: Subscriptions renew on the same day each billing period and are charged to the card on file. Two identical charges on the same day are usually a duplicate caused by a retry; ask for the order IDs. Receipts and VAT invoices are under Settings > Billing > History. Support never needs a full card number, so customers should not send one in a ticket.

title: Change or cancel your plan
body: Owners can change plan under Settings > Billing > Plan. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next renewal. Cancelling stops renewal but keeps access until the end of the paid period. Cancelling does not by itself trigger a refund; see the refund policy.

title: Known issue: blank PDF export in Safari
body: Since release 2026.10, exporting an invoice to PDF in Safari 18 can produce a blank file. Workaround: use Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or use Print > Save as PDF from the invoice view. A fix is scheduled for release 2026.11. If the problem happens in another browser, file a bug ticket with the browser and version.

title: Known issue: bank feed delays
body: Some banks deliver transactions up to 24 hours late. Feeds that disconnect repeatedly should be reconnected (see the article on connecting a bank feed). If transactions are still missing after 48 hours, create a bug ticket with the bank name and the date range.

title: Invite users and set roles
body: Owners and Admins can invite people under Settings > Users > Invite. Roles are Owner, Admin, Standard, Accountant (full ledger access, no billing) and Read-only. Invitations expire after 7 days.

title: Account security and sign-in
body: Reset a password from the sign-in page using Forgot password. Two-factor authentication is set under Profile > Security. Reports of unauthorised access, data exposure or suspected hacking must be escalated to a human on the security team; support must not investigate or confirm details in the ticket.

title: Support escalation policy
body: Escalate to a human at once for legal threats, security incidents, data-loss claims, and any customer who is angry about personal or physical safety. Urgency runs from 1 (lowest) to 4 (customer cannot work or data is at risk). An escalation should include a short summary and what has already been checked.
